claims.evidence: The report only shows the machine, pedal, and cord; no running/stitching test is shown.
A label may look like “JUKI” but the brand/model text is not fully readable; no clear country-of-origin marking is shown.
No motor sound/video or speed control/stitching demonstration is shown.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual
claims.evidence: A small accessory compartment/box is visible, but the report does not confirm contents or presence of an original manual.

claims.claim: never serviced because nothing ever went wrong
claims.evidence: No service history documentation or internal condition evidence is shown.

risks.risk: Brand/model may be misidentified (label not fully readable), which affects parts availability and value.
risks.proof: A close-up, in-focus photo of the brand/model nameplate and any serial number plate (straight-on, readable text).
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unconfirmed sewing machine brand/model (worst-case parts/compatibility uncertainty).

risks.risk: “Works perfectly” may be false: motor, speed control, and feed timing may be faulty even if the machine looks intact.
risks.proof: A short video of the machine running with the pedal (show speed changes) plus a test stitch on at least two fabric types.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst-case: needs servicing/repair).

risks.risk: Missing or incomplete accessories (presser feet, bobbins, needles, thread guides) can reduce usability and resale value.
risks.proof: A laid-out photo/video of every included accessory with counts (feet, bobbins, needles, manual, tools) and a check against the machine’s accessory list.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete accessories (worst-case: only the machine and basic items).

risks.risk: Needle/bobbin area condition may be worn or damaged (timing/feed mechanism issues not visible in a single exterior photo).
risks.proof: Photos of the bobbin case area and feed dogs (open covers), plus a close-up of the needle area showing alignment.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible internal wear (worst-case: may require adjustment/servicing).

risks.risk: Table/stand condition may hide damage (cracks, loose hinges, wobble) affecting stability during sewing.
risks.proof: A video showing the table/stand stability (push/pull test) and close-ups of joints/fasteners.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible stand wear/damage (worst-case: needs repair).

proof_requests: Clear, readable close-up photos of the brand/model nameplate and serial number plate (straight-on, high resolution).
Video of the motor running with pedal control (show slow/fast) and a short stitching test on two fabric types.
Photos/video of all accessories laid out with counts, including presser feet, bobbins, needles, and any manual (show the manual cover/title).
Photos of the bobbin case/feed dogs/needle area (open relevant covers) to confirm internal condition.
Video showing the table/stand stability and any visible wear at joints/fasteners.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a sewing machine with pedal/cord and a possibly JUKI-like label, but the key value drivers (working condition, exact model, completeness of accessories/manual) are not verifiable from the provided report. Without a running/stitching test and readable model/contents, pricing would be guesswork.
